name: Loaded Pretzel Bombs
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. Dijon mustard, plus more for serving (optional)
4 1/2 oz. cheddar, shredded, combination of white and yellow if desired(about 1 2/3 cups)
instructions: In a large, cold skillet, cook bacon over medium heat, turning occasionally, about 8-12 minutes or until crisp. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate. Discard all but 1 tsp. bacon fat.

Reduce heat to medium-low. Cook scallions, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl. Let bacon and scallions cool. Transfer bacon to a cutting board and finely chop. (Alternatively, crumble bacon with fingers.) Transfer back to a paper-towel-lined plate or to a small bowl.

In a large bowl, using a handheld mixer on medium-high speed, beat cream cheese until smooth, about 1 minute. Add mustard, pepper, and cooled scallions and mix with a spoon or spatula until just combined. Add cheddar, mozzarella, salt, and bacon and mix until just combined.
Transfer dough onto a lightly floured surface and divide into 4 equal pieces (about 158 g each). Form each into a smooth ball. Cover and let rest for 15 minutes.

Working one piece at a time, roll dough into a 6” rope, starting from the center and working toward the ends. Divide rope into 3 equal pieces (about 53 g each), tucking any added dough underneath to reach the correct volume. Roll each piece into a smooth ball.

Turn dough balls smooth side down. Flatten or stretch to a 3” round. Using a small cookie scoop, place 1 ½ tsp. filling in the center. Bring 3 edges of dough up and over the filling, firmly pinching seams to seal. Turn dough seam side down and gently shape dough until smooth and taut.
Transfer filled balls to a parchment-lined baking sheet. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 30 minutes and up to 12 hours.

Prepare a paper-towel-lined baking sheet and set aside. In a large pot, bring water and baking soda to a boil. Carefully add each dough ball, smooth side down, until floating, about 10 seconds. Using a fine-mesh sieve, transfer to the paper-towel-lined baking sheet, smooth side up. Let drain for 10 minutes.
Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 350°. Double-stack 2 baking sheets and line each with 2 pieces of parchment. Spray parchment with cooking spray.
Arrange 6 balls on each prepared sheet. Brush each dough ball with egg wash, coating all sides. Using sharp scissors, snip an “X” onto top of each round. Generously sprinkle with coarse salt.
Bake for 20 minutes, then increase oven temperature to 400° and continue to bake until deeply golden brown, about 10 minutes more. Serve warm.
description: Our loaded pretzel bombs are stuffed full of bacon and three types of cheese and wrapped in a homemade pretzel bun.

name: Churro Sandwich Cookies
ingredients: 1/3 c. (71 g) packed light brown sugar
1/3 c. (66 g) plus 1/2 cup (100 g) granulated sugar, divided
1 tbsp. plus 3/4 tsp. ground cinnamon, divided
8 tbsp. dulce de leche, store-bought or homemade
A piping bag, a large star or ridged tip
instructions: In a large bowl, using a handheld mixer on medium-high speed (or in the large bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment), beat butter, brown sugar, salt, 1/3 cup granulated sugar, and 3/4 tsp. cinnamon until pale and fluffy, 2 to 3 minutes. Beat in egg and vanilla until combined. Beat in cream of tartar and baking soda. Add flour and beat on low speed until just incorporated. Cover and refrigerate until cold, about 1 hour.
Arrange racks in upper and lower thirds of oven; preheat to 350°. Line 3 baking sheets with parchment.
In a small bowl, stir remaining 1/2 cup granulated sugar and 1 Tbsp. cinnamon.
Scoop dough into 1-Tbsp. portions (about 20 g each). Roll each ball in cinnamon sugar, then arrange 8 rounds on each prepared sheet for a total of 24.

Bake 2 sheets of cookies, rotating sheets top to bottom and front to back halfway through, until puffed and set around the edges, 9 to 11 minutes. Do not overbake; cookies will continue to set as they cool.
Let cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes, then transfer cookies to wire racks and let cool completely. Repeat with remaining cookies.

In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment (or in a medium bowl, using a handheld mixer), beat butter, cinnamon, and salt on medium-high speed until light and fluffy, 2 to 3 minutes.
Add confectioners' sugar and beat until incorporated. Add cream and continue to beat until light and fluffy, 2 to 3 minutes more.
Transfer buttercream to piping bag fitted with star tip. Pair cookies by size and arrange flat side up on a clean work surface.

Pipe a ring of buttercream around the edge of 1 cookie from each pair. Fill the center with about 2 tsp. dulce de leche. Top with remaining cookie, flat side down, and gently press to sandwich together.
description: Our churro sandwich cookies feature chewy cinnamon sugar cookies filled with cinnamon buttercream and a rich dulce de leche filling.

name: Sheet-Pan Quesadillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. In a large skillet over medium heat, heat olive oil. Add bell peppers and onion and cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Remove from skillet and set aside. Add ground beef to skillet and cook, breaking up meat with a wooden spoon, until beef is no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Drain fat, then stir in cumin, chili powder, paprika and season with salt and pepper.

On a half sheet, place 6 tortillas around the edges of the pan so that about half of each tortilla hangs over side. Place another tortilla in the center to cover pan completely, then top with ground beef, pepper and onion mixture, cheeses, and green onions.

Place another tortilla in the center (on top of all fillings), then fold each tortilla towards center. Place a second baking sheet on top of tortillas (to help quesadilla hold is shape!) and bake until tortillas are beginning to turn crispy, about 20 minutes. Remove baking sheet from on top and continue baking until tortillas are golden and crispy, about 15 minutes more.
Slice into rectangles and serve warm with sour cream and pico de gallo.
description: Make serving a crowd easier than ever with these sheet-pan quesadillas. They're not only so easy to prepare, but are loaded with your favorite fillings.

name: Apple Cheddar Bundles
ingredients: 2 medium Honeycrisp apples (about 1 1/4 lb.), cored, sliced 1/8" thick
1 (17.3 oz.) frozen package puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400° and line 2 sheet trays with parchment. In a medium bowl, toss apples, lemon zest, and 4 tablespoons honey.

Cut each pastry sheet into 4 (4.5" x 4.5") squares for a total of 8. In a small bowl, whisk egg with a splash of water. Brush outer edges of pastry with egg wash. Rotate pastry squares so a corner faces you. Place 1 tablespoon grated cheese on the bottom. Top with 10 to 11 apple slices. Place 1 tablespoon grated cheese on each side of apple slices. Fold left side over top and lightly press to seal. Fold right side over top and press to seal. Brush tops and sides of pastry with egg wash; sprinkle with sea salt. Arrange 4 pastries on each prepared tray.
Bake puffs, rotating trays halfway through, until pastry is puffed up and golden brown around the edges, 20 to 25 minutes. Let cool 5 minutes.
Arrange on a platter. Drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons honey. Top with pecans and thyme.
description: Cheddar, apples, and honey are the stars in this fall favorite recipe, which includes store-bought puff pastry, pecans, and fresh thyme.

name: Peanut Butter-Stuffed Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. granulated sugar, plus more for rolling
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° and line two large baking sheets with parchment paper. Make filling: In a medium bowl, combine peanut butter and powdered sugar and mix until smooth. Using a 2-teaspoon cookie scoop, scoop into 22 small balls and freeze until hardened, 30 minutes.

In a large bowl, combine butter, brown sugar, and sugar and beat until light and fluffy, then add egg and vanilla and mix until evenly combined. Add the flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt and mix until evenly combined.

Scoop a heaping tablespoon of the cookie dough and flatten into a pancake-like circle on the baking sheet. Place a frozen peanut butter ball on top. Bring the edges of the dough around the peanut butter ball and pinch the edges together to seal, adding more dough if necessary to cover the frozen peanut butter completely.
Roll stuffed cookie dough ball in sugar and place back on prepared baking sheets. Repeat until all dough is used, spacing the cookies about 2” apart.
Bake until the cookies are set, about 12 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.
description: Gooey peanut butter and rich chocolate come together in this irresistible stuffed cookie recipe.

name: Eggs Benedict Hash Brown Bites
ingredients: 8 slices Canadian bacon, cut into 2″ rounds or squares
1/2 cup store-bought or homemade hollandaise sauce, warmed
Thinly sliced chives and smoked paprika, for serving
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 450°. Place 3 tots in each of 8 wells of a standard 12-cup muffin tin.
Bake tots for 10 minutes. Remove from oven. Using the bottom of a small measuring cup or a spoon, flatten tots into a single layer; season with a pinch of salt.
Continue to bake until tots are crisp and adhering to each other, 8 to 10 minutes more. Let cool slightly, then transfer to a platter.
Meanwhile, one at a time, crack eggs into a small fine-mesh sieve to strain some of excess egg white. Pour each egg into individual small bowls or ramekins.
Fill a medium pot halfway with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low to maintain a very gentle simmer; the bubbles should barely be breaking the surface.

With your bowl hovering over the water, gently drop one egg into simmering water. Gently stir water around egg, keeping it moving in a circular motion. Repeat with another egg to cook 2 eggs at the same time.
Cook until whites are set, 3 to 4 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a paper towel-lined plate. Repeat with remaining eggs; season with a pinch of salt.
Top each tater tot base with a slice of bacon, then top with a poached egg and 1 Tbsp. hollandaise sauce. Sprinkle with chives and paprika.
description: Our Eggs Benedict hash brown bites are sure to satisfy all of your breakfast cravings.

name: Boman Martinez-Reid’s Harissa Egg  Wild Rice Bowl
ingredients: Handful of walnuts or your favorite nuts, crushed
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.
Meanwhile, in a medium skillet over medium heat, heat oil. Fry eggs sunny-side up; sprinkle with harissa while they cook.
Place hot cooked rice in a large bowl. Add avocado. Squeeze juice of lemon over and stir to combine. Add harissa seasoning to taste and stir again. Fold in walnuts.
Transfer rice mixture to a serving bowl. Top with sunny-side-up eggs. Finish with a light sprinkle of turmeric.
description: Boman Martinez-Reid stopped by the Delish Test Kitchen to teach us how to make his harissa egg and wild rice bowl.

name: Butternut Squash Latte
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz. freshly brewed espresso or 2 oz. freshly brewed coffee
instructions: In a medium pot over medium heat, bring milk, cardamom, squash, brown sugar, and allspice to a simmer. Remove from heat and let sit for 5 minutes, then strain through a fine-mesh sieve into a small bowl; discard solids.
Using a frother or small whisk, vigorously mix until frothy, if desired.
Pour espresso into a mug. Stir in salt. Top with foamed milk, then sprinkle with turmeric. Garnish with cinnamon stick.
description: Creamy, warmly spiced, and just sweet enough to feel like a treat, our butternut squash latte is everything you love about the season in a single, sippable mug.

name: Bagel Breakfast Sliders
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 350°. Grease a 13” x 9” baking dish with cooking spray.
In a large bowl, whisk eggs and milk until light and frothy.
In a cold, large skillet over medium heat, cook bacon, turning occasionally, until crispy, 8 to 10 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate. Pour off all but 1 Tbsp. fat.

Pour egg mixture into skillet. Cook over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally with a spatula or wooden spoon, until eggs are nearly set, 2 to 3 minutes; season with salt and pepper and stir in chives. Remove from heat.

Spread cream cheese onto bottom halves of bagels. Arrange in prepared dish, side by side. Spread egg mixture over bagels. Crumble bacon over. Sprinkle with cheddar, then close with top halves of bagels. Brush tops with melted butter. Sprinkle with everything bagel seasoning.
Bake sliders until bagels are toasted and cheese is melted, about 10 minutes.
description: This recipe transforms the classic grab-and-go breakfast sandwich into a shareable start to your day that any brunch crowd will be obsessed with.

name: Crispy Hash Brown Breakfast Tostadas
ingredients: Hot sauce (such as Frank’s), for serving
instructions: In a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat, heat oil. Add hash brown and cook, undisturbed, until browned on the bottom, 1 to 2 minutes.

Flip hash brown and, using a lightly greased burger press or spatula, gently press down to flatten. Loosen patty with a spatula to ensure it’s not sticking, then cook until browned on the bottom, 1 to 2 minutes more.
Flip hash brown; lightly season with salt. Top with cheese. Cover and cook until cheese is melted, about 30 seconds.
Transfer to a plate. Top with egg. Sprinkle with bacon (if using). Serve with hot sauce alongside.
description: In our crispy hash brown breakfast tostadas, a store-bought frozen hash brown patty is pressed and pan-fried until crisp, then topped with cheese, a fried egg, and crispy bacon for a fast, satisfying bite that hits every crunchy, cheesy note.

name: Jelly Donut French Toast
ingredients: 1 loaf brioche, cut into 6 thick slices, preferably day old
3 tbsp. butter, plus more as needed
instructions: In the bottom of each slice of bread, make a 2” wide slit to create a pocket, being careful not to cut all the way through.
Fill a pastry bag or resealable baggie with jam and fill each pocket with jam.
In a large shallow bowl, whisk together milk, eggs, and vanilla. Dip each slice of bread in mixture, turning to coat.
In a medium skillet over medium heat, melt butter. Working in batches, add bread to skillet and cook until golden, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Repeat with remaining slices, adding more butter as needed.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve immediately.
description: Our jelly donut French toast combines the jammy filling of a jelly donut with the pillowy soft goodness of French toast, and, of course, plenty of powdered sugar.

name: Slow-Cooker Pumpkin Butter
ingredients: 1/3 c. (71 g) packed light brown sugar
1 tbsp. plus 1 tsp. pumpkin pie spice
instructions: In a slow cooker (at least 2 qt.), mix pumpkin puree, granulated sugar, cider, brown sugar, pumpkin pie spice, vanilla, and salt until combined.
Cover and cook on High, stirring every hour, until desired consistency is reached, 2 to 3 hours.
Let cool slightly, then transfer to mason jars and refrigerate until ready to use.
description: You'll want to eat this easy slow-cooker pumpkin butter with everything this Fall.

name: Dole Whip Mimosas
ingredients: 1/4 c. sugar, for rimming champagne flutes
instructions: Pour sugar onto a shallow dish. Run a pineapple wedge around 6 champagne flutes and dip in sugar. Set aside.
In a tall glass, stir together pineapple juice and coconut milk until combined. Pour into champagne flutes and top off with champagne.
Garnish each flute with whipped topping and a fresh pineapple wedge.
description: Want to jazz up your boozy brunch? Try these Dole Whip Mimosas from Delish.com.

name: Blueberry Cornbread
ingredients: 1 tbsp. vegetable oil or melted butter
instructions: Preheat a grill to 400° and bank coals to one side or, if using a gas grill, turn off burners on one side to create an indirect heat zone. (If baking in an oven, preheat to 400°.) Grease a 10" cast-iron skillet with oil.

In a medium bowl, whisk cornmeal, flour, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt to combine. In a large bowl, whisk eggs until combined, then whisk in butter, sour cream, and milk. Using a rubber spatula, fold in dry ingredients until no streaks remain.
Pour half of batter into prepared pan. Sprinkle 1 cup blueberries over, then top with remaining batter. Top with remaining blueberries and sprinkle with granulated sugar, if using.

Place cast-iron skillet on grill over indirect heat and cover grill. Bake, making sure temperature remains consistent, until cornbread is golden brown and firm to the touch, and a tester inserted into center comes out with a couple moist crumbs attached, 25 to 30 minutes. (If baking in an oven, place cast-iron skillet in center of oven and bake 25 to 30 minutes.) Let cool at least 15 minutes before serving.
description: Featuring a crisp, buttery crust and blueberries galore, this easy skillet blueberry cornbread will become your new favorite cookout classic.

name: Breakfast Crunchwrap Supreme
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together sour cream, lime juice, jalapeño and paprika. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside.
Bake frozen hash brown patties according to package instructions.

In a large bowl, combine eggs and milk and whisk until frothy. In a medium nonstick pan, melt butter over medium heat. Pour egg mixture into the pan. Let set slightly then reduce heat to medium-low. Drag the eggs with a spatula or wooden spoon to create curds. When the eggs are almost cooked to your liking, season with salt and pepper. Fold in chives and remove from heat.

Spread the jalapeño sauce onto the center of each flour tortilla, then top each with a hash brown patty, scrambled eggs, bacon, cheddar and Monterey Jack. Fold tortillas around the center, creating pleats. After wrapping, quickly invert crunchwraps so the pleats are on the bottom and they stay together.

In a medium nonstick pan over medium heat, heat a very thin layer of vegetable oil. Working one at a time, add crunchwrap seam-side down and cook until tortilla is golden on the bottom, 3 to 5 minutes. Flip crunchwrap and cook until the other side is golden, 3 to 5 minutes more.
Repeat with remaining crunchwraps. Cut each in half and serve warm.
description: If you love the Taco Bell classic, skip the drive-thru and make it at home with our easy breakfast Crunchwrap Supreme recipe.

name: Blueberry Scones
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. (300 g.) all-purpose flour, plus more for surface
1/2 c. (1 stick) cold unsalted butter, cut into cubes, plus 2 Tbsp. unsalted butter, melted
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk flour, granulated sugar, baking powder, and salt. Add butter and cut into flour mixture with your hands or a pastry cutter until crumbles are the size of peas. Add blueberries and lemon zest and toss to coat.
Make a well in center of blueberry mixture. Pour egg, buttermilk, almond extract, and vanilla extract into well. Mix with your hands until just combined.

Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat to an 8" circle. Cut into 8 triangles and arrange on a large parchment-lined baking sheet. Brush scones with melted butter and sprinkle with coarse sugar. Freeze 10 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°. Bake scones until lightly golden, about 25 minutes. Let cool 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack and let cool completely.
In a small bowl, whisk confectioners' sugar, lemon zest and juice, and cream until smooth, adding more cream if needed until desired consistency is reached.
Drizzle glaze over cooled scones.
description: These buttermilk scones have a sugary, crispy crust, a soft and pillowy middle, and pockets of juicy, exploding blueberries.

name: Fro-Yo Fruit Bites
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine yogurt, milk, honey and vanilla and whisk until smooth.
In an ice tray, distribute fruit in each of the cube molds.
Spoon yogurt mixture over fruit, filling molds completely. Freeze for 5 hours, or until frozen solid.
description: These fro-yo fruit bites combine yogurt, fresh fruit, and honey to create the perfect frosty snack or on-the-go breakfast.

name: How To Make Homemade Croutons
ingredients: 1 loaf of crusty bread, cut into 1" cubes (about 6 cups)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. In a large bowl, toss cubed bread with oil and butter until evenly coated. Add in salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, rosemary, and Parmesan, and toss to combine until evenly distributed. Divide seasoned bread between two large baking sheets.
Bake until golden and crispy, flipping halfway through, about 15 minutes total.
Let cool completely and store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.
description: Your croutons, your call. Grab some bread, a little oil or butter, your favorite spices or herbs, and get ready for some crunchy goodness to happen in just 20 minutes.

name: Buffalo Ranch Chickpea Wraps
ingredients: 1/4 head of napa cabbage, shredded (about 3 cups)
2 tbsp. thinly sliced chives or scallions
1/4 c. ranch dressing, plus more for serving
4 (10") high-protein or regular tortilla wraps, warmed
instructions: In a large bowl, drizzle chickpeas with oil; season with 1/2 tsp. salt and toss to combine. Sprinkle with ranch seasoning and toss to coat. Transfer chickpeas to an air-fryer basket; reserve bowl for sauce.
Cook at 400°, shaking basket halfway through, until crisp and starting to brown, 15 to 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, in another large bowl, toss cabbage, carrot, celery, and chives; season with remaining 1/2 tsp. salt. Add ranch dressing and vinegar and toss to coat.
In reserved bowl, whisk hot sauce, honey, and butter. Add chickpeas and toss to coat.

Divide chickpea mixture and cabbage mixture among tortillas. Top with cheese (if using). Fold in left and right sides of each tortilla, then fold end closest to you over filling. Tightly roll up from bottom end, keeping sides tucked in, to form a burrito shape. Cut each wrap in half.
description: These buffalo ranch chickpea wraps have that Buffalo flavor I love, in a meatless, handheld format that’s easy to take on the go.

name: Creamy Peanut-Lime Chicken With Noodles
ingredients: 2 tbsp. tamari or reduced-sodium soy sauce
2 small or 1 large boneless, skinless chicken breasts (about 8 oz.), chopped into 1/2" pieces
1 small red bell pepper, seeds and ribs removed, thinly sliced
3 scallions, white and green parts separated, thinly sliced
1/3 c. roasted, salted peanuts, finely chopped
instructions: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil; generously season with salt. Add noodles and stir to prevent sticking. Remove from heat and let soak until tender, 13 to 15 minutes. Drain in a colander, then rinse with cold water.
Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, whisk peanut butter, chili sauce, tamari, sriracha, lime zest, lime juice, 1/4 tsp. salt, and 1/4 cup warm water until smooth; set aside.

In a large skillet over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add chicken, season with salt, and cook, stirring often, until lightly golden in spots and almost cooked through, about 4 minutes. Add bell pepper, garlic, white scallion parts, and ginger; season with salt, if needed. Reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring often, until peppers are tender, about 3 minutes more.
Add noodles to skillet and toss well to combine. Remove from heat, add reserved sauce, and toss to coat.
Divide noodles among bowls. Top with green scallion parts, cilantro, basil, and peanuts. Serve with lime wedges alongside.
description: Creamy peanut butter combines with chili sauces, garlic, and ginger in this dinner for a sauce that perfectly coats rice noodles and chicken.

name: Chopped Greek Chicken Sandwich
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. coarsely chopped rotisserie chicken meat
1/3 c. coarsely chopped pitted Kalamata olives
instructions: In a large bowl, toss cucumber, tomato, onion, garlic, chicken, feta, and olives. Fold in tzatziki, lemon juice, oregano, pepper, and salt until combined.
Divide lettuce among rolls. Stuff with chicken mixture.
description: This chopped Greek chicken sandwich combines classic Greek salad ingredients with store-bought staples for a quick and easy lunch.

name: Spicy Tuna  Crispy Rice Bowls
ingredients: 4 c. cooked long-grain or sushi rice
Chili crisp and toasted seaweed snacks, for serving
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet over medium heat, heat 2 tsp. oil. Add rice and spread into an even layer. Using the handle of a wooden spoon, poke 5 to 6 holes throughout to let steam escape. Let cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes.

Distribute remaining 3 tsp. oil into holes and around edges on pan. Continue to cook until bottom side of rice is very golden, 20 to 30 minutes more. You can add more oil as needed around the edges to encourage color. To check on rice, lift edges or near a hole in the center with a spoon. If you feel your stove has hot spots on it, rotate the pan every 5 minutes for even coloring.
Divide rice among bowls. Top with a scoop of spicy tuna, edamame, avocado, cucumbers, and scallions.
Drizzle with chili crisp and serve with seaweed snacks alongside.
description: This spicy tuna bowl with crispy rice and veggies is a quick and easy lunch we're obsessed with.

name: Starbucks Copycat S'mores Frappuccino
ingredients: 1/3 c. cold brew (or strong brewed coffee, chilled)
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine 1 tablespoon marshmallow fluff and 1 tablespoon heavy cream. Beat until smooth, then add remaining heavy cream and beat until stiff peaks form, 3 to 4 minutes.
Spread the remaining marshmallow fluff inside the bottom of your glass, then drizzle with chocolate syrup.

Add coffee and milk, then ice, and then vanilla ice cream into blender. Blend until smooth. Break graham cracker in half, then break one half into another half. Add 3/4 of the graham cracker to blender and reserve the last 1/4 for topping. Blend until smooth.
Pour drink into prepared glass and top with whipped marshmallow cream and a drizzle of chocolate syrup. Crush remaining graham cracker and sprinkle on top.
description: Coffee, marshmallow, chocolate, graham crackers, AND ice cream? Yes, please!

name: Copycat Costco Sheet Cake
ingredients: 2 (15.25-oz.) boxes white cake mix (we used Pillsbury)
A piping bag, a star tip
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat oven to 350°. Grease 2 (13" x 9") metal baking pans with cooking spray; line each with parchment, allowing excess to extend over the two long sides for easy removal.

In a large bowl (or the large bowl of a stand mixer), whisk cake mix and salt. Add egg whites, sour cream, milk, oil, and vanilla. Using an electric mixer on medium speed (or the paddle attachment of the stand mixer), beat until combined and no lumps remain, about 2 minutes.
Divide batter between prepared pans, smoothing to distribute across bottom of pans (batter will be thicker than typical box cake mix batter).
Bake cakes until lightly browned on top, pulling away from the sides of the pan, and springy to the touch, 20 to 25 minutes.
Let cakes cool at least 10 minutes in pans, then invert onto a wire rack and let cool completely.
Remove parchment. Using a serrated knife, trim domed tops off cakes. Discard cake (or save for snacking!).

In the large clean bowl of stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, beat cream cheese, confectioners’ sugar, and salt, scraping down sides of bowl as needed, until smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Add milk and instant pudding and beat until combined, about 1 minute more. Scrape down bowl, then add heavy cream and continue to beat until thick and light, 1 to 2 minutes more.

Arrange one layer of cake on a platter. Top with mousse. Using an offset spatula, spread in an even layer, leaving a 1/2" border on all sides. Top with remaining cake, trimmed side down. Refrigerate cake until ready to use.
In the large bowl of stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, beat shortening, water, vanilla, and salt on medium-high speed until smooth and creamy.

Add 1 cup (113 g) confectioners’ sugar and beat on low speed just until combined. Continue to add confectioners’ sugar in 1-cup increments, beating after each addition, until all sugar is added. Increase mixer speed to medium-high and beat until smooth and fluffy, about 1 minute more.

Transfer one-quarter of frosting to a piping bag fitted with a star tip. Using offset spatula, frost top and sides of cake with remaining frosting. Pipe a shell border around top and bottom of cake as desired. Decorate with sprinkles (if using).
description: This copycat Costco sheet cake features layers of fluffy white cake filled vanilla cheesecake mousse covered with light and airy frosting.

name: Copycat TruFru
ingredients: 16 oz. fresh strawberries, tops removed, halved
1 1/2 c. dark or milk chocolate chips
1 c. dark or milk chocolate chips
instructions: Arrange strawberries cut side down on paper towels to soak up excess moisture.
In a small microwave-safe bowl, heat white chocolate chips and 1 Tbsp. oil in 30-second increments, stirring between each, until melted and smooth, about 1 minute total.
Using a fork, dip strawberry halves into chocolate. Tap fork on side of bowl to remove excess chocolate.
Arrange on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Freeze until chocolate is hardened, about 15 minutes.
In another small microwave-safe bowl, heat dark chocolate chips and remaining 1 Tbsp. oil in 30-second increments, stirring between each, until melted and smooth, about 1 minute total.

Using fork, dip strawberries into dark chocolate. Tap fork on side of bowl to remove excess chocolate. Return to baking sheet. Continue to freeze until completely solid, at least 1 hour and up to overnight.
In a small microwave-safe bowl, heat white chocolate chips and 1 Tbsp. oil in 30-second increments, stirring between each, until melted and smooth, about 1 minute total.
Using a fork and working gently, dip raspberries into chocolate. Tap fork on side of bowl to remove excess chocolate.
Arrange on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Freeze until chocolate is hardened, about 15 minutes.
In another microwave-safe bowl,heat dark chocolate chips and remaining 1 Tbsp. oil in 30-second increments, stirring between each, until melted and smooth, about 1 minute total.

Using fork, dip raspberries into dark chocolate. ztap fork on side of bowl to remove excess chocolate. Return to baking sheet. Continue to freeze until completely solid, at least 1 hour and up to overnight.
In a small microwave-safe bowl, microwave peanut butter until melted, about 45 seconds.
Using a fork, dip bananas into peanut butter. Tap fork on side of bowl to remove excess peanut butter. Arrange on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Freeze until chilled, about 30 minutes.
In another small microwave-safe bowl, heat dark chocolate chips and oil in 30-second increments, stirring between each, until melted and smooth, about 1 minute total.

Using fork, dip bananas into dark chocolate. Tap fork on side of bowl to remove excess chocolate. Return to baking sheet. Continue to freeze until completely solid, at least 1 hour and up to overnight.
description: TruFru is pretty common in most grocery stores, but it’s also just fun to make your own at home. Plus, with my recipe, you can get versatile with whatever fruit or chocolate you prefer!
